connector.name: Seo Monster
connector.registryDescription: SEO MCP over Search Console, GA4, PageSpeed Insights, Cloudflare, IndexNow, CrUX, technical-SEO.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package seo-monster. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the avansaber account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: SEO_MCP_GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT
env.description: Path to your Desktop-app OAuth client-secrets JSON, downloaded from Google Cloud Console. Required for Search Console, Indexing, and GA4 tools.

env.name: SEO_MCP_GOOGLE_TOKEN
env.description: Writable path where the cached OAuth token is stored. On first use, a browser opens for one-time consent and the token is written here. Default: ${HOME}/.config/seo-monster/token.json

env.name: SEO_MCP_GSC_DEFAULT_SITE
env.description: Default Search Console property, e.g. 'sc-domain:example.com' or 'https://www.example.com/'.

env.name: SEO_MCP_GA4_PROPERTY_ID
env.description: Default GA4 property, e.g. 'properties/123456789' or bare '123456789'.

env.name: PSI_API_KEY
env.description: Google API key shared by PageSpeed Insights and Chrome UX Report History tools. Optional; both work anonymously at a tighter rate limit when unset.

env.name: CF_API_TOKEN
env.description: Cloudflare API token. Optional; needed only for the Cloudflare tools. Scopes: Zone:Read, DNS:Read, Account Analytics:Read, and (only when destructive mode is on) Cache Purge:Purge.

env.name: SEO_MCP_INDEXNOW_KEY
env.description: IndexNow shared key (any 8-128 hex string you generate). Required only for the IndexNow tools. Host the key file at https://<your-host>/<key>.txt for engine verification.

env.name: SEO_MCP_INDEXNOW_KEY_LOCATION
env.description: Override the default IndexNow key-file URL (https://<host>/<key>.txt). Set only if you host the key file at a non-standard path.

env.name: SEO_MCP_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE
env.description: Set to 'true' to enable the Cloudflare cache-purge tools. Default false: all destructive tools refuse to run.
